info.title: Wolfcreek Lodge public availability API
info.summary: Read-only availability and direct-booking price for one stay.
info.description: Two vacation homes in Winthrop, WA, sold as three mutually exclusive configurations: wolf-creek-lodge (the House), wolf-creek-apartment (the Apartment) and wolf-creek-retreat-combo (both let together). Booking the combined listing blocks both units for those dates, and booking either unit blocks the combined listing; the database enforces this, and every answer here applies it. Prices are in USD, for direct booking, and before tax: Washington State sales tax and local lodging tax are added to the booking total. Read-only, no key, no guest data. To book, send the guest to the request form on the property page; there is no booking endpoint for agents. Guide: https://wolfcreeklodge.us/agents

get.summary: Check availability and price for one stay
get.description: Whether the property is free for the whole stay, the minimum stay that applies to those dates (it varies by season), the direct-booking price, and which other configurations are free for the same dates if this one is not. Check-in may not be in the past or more than 18 months ahead; stays are limited to 60 nights.
